titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Hello! My name is Rania. I am twelve years old and I am from Tunisia. I have a small family: my father, my mother, my little brother and me. My father is a teacher and my mother is a nurse. My brother is seven years old and he is very funny. We live in a nice flat in Nabeul. I have a pet: a little white rabbit called Bobo. I love him very much. Every day, I go to school with my friends. My favourite colour is blue and my favourite food is couscous.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) How old is Rania and where is she from?   (2 marks)
2) What is her mother's job?   (2 marks)
3) What pet does Rania have?   (2 marks)
4) What is her favourite food?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "am / is / are": My brother ______ seven years old.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the plural of: family ______ ; friend ______.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with the correct possessive (my / her): Rania loves ______ rabbit.   (1,5 marks)
4) Find in the text the opposite of "big" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Introduce yourself in about 6 lines: your name, your age, your family, and your favourite things (colour, food, sport…). Use the present simple.
